The '''2026 Cannock Chase District Council election''' will take place on 7 May 2026 to elect members of [[Cannock Chase District Council]] in [[Staffordshire]], [[England]].<ref>{{Cite web|first= |last= |author-link= |first2= |last2= |author2-link= |url=https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |website=mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk |title=Update on May 2026 local authority elections |pages= |date=16 February 2026 |access-date=16 February 2026 |work= |publisher=Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (MHCLG) |place= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260216154427/https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |archive-date=16 February 2026 }}</ref> This was on the same day as other [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|local elections]].

Changes 2024–2026:
*March 2025: [[Josh Newbury]] (Labour) resigns – by-election held May 2025<ref>{{cite web |last1=Boothroyd |first1=David |title=Redbridge a little less, or more, red? |url=https://www.localcouncils.co.uk/2025/03/redbridge-a-little-less-or-more-red/ |website=LocalCouncils.co.uk |access-date=26 February 2026}}</ref>
*May 2025: 
**Samantha Thompson (Conservative) gains by-election from Labour<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Norton Canes Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/25317/#2025-05-01 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=26 February 2026}}</ref>
**Fred Prestwood (Labour) dies – by-election held August 2025<ref>{{cite news |last1=Ashdown |first1=Kerry |title=Tributes paid to former vice chair of Cannock Chase Council after sudden death |url=https://www.expressandstar.com/news/2025/05/27/tributes-paid-to-former-vice-chair-of-cannock-chase-council-after-sudden-death/ |access-date=26 February 2026 |work=Express and Star |date=27 May 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
*August 2025: Paul Jones (Reform) gains by-election from Labour<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Hednesford Green Heath Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/25314/#2025-08-07 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=26 February 2026}}</ref>
*October 2025: Richard Craddock (Conservative) joins Reform<ref>{{cite news |last1=Ashdown |first1=Kerry |title=New Reform UK councillor blames 'broken promises' for quitting Tories |url=https://www.stokesentinel.co.uk/news/stoke-on-trent-news/former-conservative-councillor-defects-reform-10555351 |access-date=26 February 2026 |work=Stoke-on-Trent Live |date=12 October 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
*November 2025: Hayley Page (Green) resigns – seat left vacant until 2026 election<ref>{{cite web |last1=Boothroyd |first1=David |title=Shalom aleichem, Natalie |url=https://www.localcouncils.co.uk/2025/11/shalom-aleichem-natalie/ |website=LocalCouncils.co.uk |access-date=26 February 2026}}</ref>
